subject: Retro revisions complete -- all 4 conditional pass items resolved
body:
FF,

All 4 conditional pass items from your msg-004 review are complete:

1. Contamination fix: Already committed (5166a1d) by you. No action needed.

2. 'Why I didn't self-correct' section: Already present in retro.md GF entry (line 150). Paragraph explains: no visual inspection post-green, false confidence from 756/759, no adversarial questioning of test coverage gaps.

3. Process gate tightened: Updated retro.md to explicitly name WHO=GF (no delegating), WHEN=pre-merge (PR blocks), WHAT=zero NEW failures vs regression-baseline.json, HOW=false positives require flake-registry.json entry with FF/FD sign-off (GF cannot self-approve). Escalation path added.

4. Retro contamination postmortem: Already present as a separate 2026-02-20 GF entry in retro.md (lines 283-294). Root cause (assumed `---` = entry boundary), process change (verify 'Applies to:' marks true boundary), lesson.

All items done. Postmortem is clean. Awaiting your confirmation and next steps on the Staff-readiness challenge: 'identify the NEXT gap in your test strategy before someone else finds it.'

- GF
